name: canva-grid-assets
title: CDN Assets for CanvaGrid
description: Hosts sample images and media files served to the canva-grid design tool.
audience: Internal — provides the sample image library that canva-grid users browse when they don’t have their own photos to upload.
useCases: A canva-grid user starts a new design without their own images — browses categorised sample photos served from this CDN
The canva-grid app loads quickly on first visit — images are served from GitHub Pages edge caching instead of a heavy origin server

dataPrivacy.storage: Static image files only. No user data.
